prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Pasadena, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1040; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just go by my first name for this, if that's all right.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was in Pasadena, Texas, heading toward a shopping center on the left side of the road. I had to turn left into the parking lot.

Q: Walk me through what you were doing right before the impact.

A: I had my blinker on and I was slowing down. There was a gap in oncoming traffic, so I started the turn. Then a car came from the opposite direction and hit the front passenger side of my vehicle.

Q: Were you moving when it happened, or had you already stopped?

A: I was almost through the turn. I was moving slowly, maybe ten or fifteen miles an hour.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. It came out of nowhere, or at least I didn't notice it until it was on top of me.

Q: How are you feeling now?

A: My neck is really stiff and sore. The doctor said it's whiplash. My shoulders hurt too, and I've had headaches since it happened.

Q: Have you received medical treatment for these symptoms?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same day and I've been going to physical therapy twice a week since.

Q: Did anyone else ride in your vehicle at the time?

A: No, I was alone.

Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Just that I was careful and I did everything I was supposed to. I'd like this to be handled as quickly as possible.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
